replies.label: Train times
replies.text: Sure, I can help with that. The next train to the city leaves from platform four at twenty past nine, and it should arrive a little after ten. Would you like me to set a reminder?

replies.label: Study helper
replies.text: Gradient descent moves the weights a small step in the direction that lowers the loss. The learning rate decides how big each step is, so if the loss starts to jump around, try a smaller value.

replies.label: Order status
replies.text: Thanks for waiting. Your order was shipped this morning and should arrive on Thursday. I have sent the tracking link to your email address.

limitations: One English female voice (LJSpeech). The speaker-ID conditioning in the code is not trained in these checkpoints.
English only. Numbers, money, times, percentages and common abbreviations are written out; acronyms, roman numerals, units, dates with slashes and URLs are not.
Whisper still mis-transcribes about 12% of words (WER 11.6%) for the best checkpoint, so the output is not a reliable pronunciation reference.

examples.label: Paragraph
examples.text:
Our team trained this speech model from scratch for a university course project. It reads English text aloud, one sentence at a time.

Please call Stella and ask her to bring these things with her from the store. How much wood would a woodchuck chuck if a woodchuck could chuck wood?
